Learn Photopea by making a nameplate and logo. Complete the lessons in order, then make your own design.

## Choose a tool

| Tool | Best reason to use it |
|---|---|
| [Photopea](https://www.photopea.com/) | Runs in a browser and is the class default. |
| [GIMP](https://www.gimp.org/) | Free desktop image editor. |
| [Adobe Photoshop](https://www.adobe.com/products/photoshop.html) | Industry-standard commercial image editor. |

Use Photopea unless your teacher approves another tool. Keep the editable source file and export a PNG or JPG for use.

## Lessons

::: {.ter-path-grid}
::: {.ter-path-card}
### 1. Build the Nameplate Text

Make an 11 × 4 inch file, leave room for a logo, and choose a readable font.

[Open Lesson 1](01-nameplate-text-photopea.qmd)
:::
::: {.ter-path-card}
### 2. Trace a Rough Logo

Turn a photographed drawing into clean, editable vector lines.

[Open Lesson 2](rough-sketch-to-svg-photopea.qmd)
:::
::: {.ter-path-card}
### 3. Combine Logo & Nameplate

Follow the worked ANDRADE example and export the complete design.

[Open Lesson 3](03-combine-logo-nameplate.qmd)
:::
::: {.ter-path-card}
### 4. Design Your Own Name Tag

Use the tutorial skills to make and defend an original name-and-logo design.

[Open the project](../03-laser-cutting/01-name-logo.qmd)
:::
:::

Use [Accessible Design](../accessible-design/index.qmd) to compare fonts, test readability, check contrast, and write useful alt text.

## Make something

- [Gaming / Roblox character logo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mchoizRTY-s)
- [Apex Legends thumbnail](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=t9V6Wp_OnQk)
- [Make a YouTube logo in under five minutes](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QmB14oyGWcw)
- [Photopea beginner crash course](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6dwSRbkSuq8)

Pick one video, make your own version, then change the wording, colours, images, spacing, and layout so the result fits your purpose.
